dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Might you have any special gadgets in stock?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, are you interested in gadgets too, Miss Jahoda? Hehe, I'm not going to try and fix your arm. At least, not here...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, I don't need you to fix my arm. I'm just here to ask some questions on Boss Nef's behalf. The Fon{RUBY#[D]intel}tas you ordered from us have arrived. May I assume that you have your pay{RUBY#[D]intel for exchange}ment ready?

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: Oh, the shipment's here? That's fast. The Curatorium of Secrets is certainly reliable as always. The payment has of course been prepared long ago — falling behind has never been ou{RUBY#[D]Marechaussee Phantom}r habit.

dialogues.speaker: Lestocq
dialogues.text: However, please kindly let Lady Nefer know she must come collect it at her earliest convenience. If the ice used for cooling melts, the Fontas may lose their fla{RUBY#[D]timeliness}vor.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, don't worry, they will be delivered on time. Just don't forget the payment, Mr. Lestocq. I'll go report back now.
